fields.Name: T155 - Deep Link App URL Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the routed deep-link entry (app/:appName -> ResourceResolver/app load) initiated from the URL, distinct from clicking the app-switcher dropdown and from reload-based session persistence.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Navigate the browser's address bar directly to the deep-link URL http://localhost:4200/app/Admin and press Enter. Verify the Explorer resolves this route and loads the Admin application (its landing screen or a section list), rather than showing a 404, a blank page, or bouncing to Home. Seeing the Admin app render from the typed URL is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Navigating the address bar to /app/Admin loads the Admin application (its nav sections or landing render)
The route resolves to the correct app rather than a not-found/blank page or an unexpected redirect to Home
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
